messages:
Riley: FYI I spotted a quantile mismatch on the latency dashboard for /v1/complete during the rollout. p50 stayed flat but p95 jumped then drifted away from the raw histogram.
Zara: Which rollout and timeframe?
Riley: Canary ramp in us-west between 16:02-16:10. Query: `percentile(50,95,99) over 30s` with 4m smoothing.
Omar: Could be merge-ordering. We compute per-route sketches then merge and smooth. If one route has a tiny high tail it can pull p95 when weight changes.
Riley: Sample snapshot: total 2100, merged_p95_count ~ 9, alt-route count 4 with latencies ~2.6s.
Zara: That's tiny. The merged sketch will be unstable. Can we show route-contributions in the same panel? A small stacked heatmap under the line with route weights would help.
console-team: We can add a route-annotated heatmap and a provenance pill: "percentiles from merged t-digests (contributors: 3, low confidence)". Also adding a hover action "Show per-route percentiles".
telemetry-bot: alert: merged_p95_delta >30% on /v1/complete (detected 2025-06-21T16:06Z)
Omar: Short-term fix: suppress merged percentile alerts when merged_sample_count < 50 and instead emit per-route p95 alerts. Also add a guard: if any contributor < 20 samples, mark merged pcts as low-confidence.
Zara: UX idea: a tiny inline explainer in the panel: "Why did p95 jump? If a low-volume route with high tail was added or weight-changed, merged percentiles can be skewed - click to compare per-route."
Riley: I can reproduce by simulating 99/1 traffic split with a 2.5s tail on the 1% route. I'll attach the replay.
Omar: Longer term: consider keeping a short-window exact histogram cache for endpoints with frequent rollouts or high-cardinality routing. That would let "exact recompute" be O(1) for recent windows.
console-team: Action items: console-team -> add provenance pill + heatmap + hover per-route; Omar -> change alert rules and add tdigest-merge diagnostic that logs contributor counts when delta>20%; Riley -> upload replay and sample dump.
Zara: Also add a one-liner to the runbook: "If p95 jumps but p50 doesn't, check per-route counts and recent routing/quota events before paging infra." :white_check_mark:
Riley: Thanks all, opening the issue now and tagging @console-team @telemetry for follow-up.
